READ-ONLY P1R INTEGRATION AUDIT; no edits, reservations, downloads, credentials, remote text, or model changes.

Verified exact admitted runtime handoff /private/tmp/storymodel4s-amr-runtime.EkToyR/runtime-handoff.json SHA-256 05b728735f243b6c26bcfd6a09f992f588562a5c7587af2daa0f77940dd7d44c and approved provider candidate cand-13J7K02VCBNBYWQG8354Y9MGZY at 73bc9af9309c237717b003faaa1a635d0e39a603.

Executable seam map:
StorySource.fromText -> SurfaceAnalyzer.analyze -> ParserSentenceInput.fromAtlas -> ParserBatch.validated -> [missing concrete ParserTransport[F]] -> JsonAmrCandidateProvider.parse -> ParserBatchResult.conforms -> ParserAttempt.result / ParserProposal.evidence. Internally: AmrCandidates.fromPenman -> RoleCanonicalizer.fromUnchecked (AmrGraph[Checked, CanonicalRoles]) -> ToChart.convert (PropositionChart[Checked]) -> PropositionEvidence.of.
The production path then stops: NarrativeCompilerInput.of also requires SituationAttempt, ContextAssignmentAttempt, StorySummaryAttempt, SegmentMembershipAttempt, and optional CausalAttempt. No production producer from checked charts/evidence to those attempts exists; only test-fixture construction was found. Once a valid compilation exists: NarrativeCompiler.compile -> NarrativeCompilation.validated -> StorySourceView.validated; recall StorySource.fromText -> RecallSegmenter.segment -> CandidateGenerator.generate -> GraphHsmm.infer, whose HsmmResult carries posterior P and transition flow F.

Data:
- Held-out Alice Chapter I is predeclared on board with raw Gutenberg artifact SHA-256 01b38ea4c710a84bc18d0bd41271a5a1a92b94e97b2812f4dece97d4a694725e, but no admitted derived chapter checksum, SurfaceAtlas ledger, or current local artifact was found. Missing admitted executable data.
- NFRD Baseball source/113-recall export exists only in pending cand-67RYQ5MJJT5BV8NY7G150S1P0 at 99602baac56b1a5afad5359a5c4bd019f2281343; source path experiment_materials/stimuli/baseball_transcript.txt, file SHA-256 030810ed..., StoryId story:86498fdb3920, recall manifest metadata/baseball-recall-transcripts.tsv digest d5cf7239..., frozen split 57/28/28. Candidate is unlanded and the external participant snapshot is not presently materialized. Missing admitted/current data.
- Sherlock has 17 local digest-bound recalls, but using them here would depend on later C1/D0 film compilation, so they are not a P1 substitute.

Fixed question:
The first accepted question is P1 v3 Baseball Diagnostic: across participant-by-eligible-source-situation cells, identify reproducibly high/low target-episode visitation and typed compression, blending, and revisiting patterns. Existing PopulationAggregate.visitationRate uses outcome-dependent groundedSubjects as eligibility and lacks the required revisitation/compression/blending report. One admitted transcript cannot answer this population question. Therefore no existing end-to-end path currently answers the fixed scientific question.

Classified blockers:
MISSING API: concrete subprocess ParserTransport execution witness; chart/evidence -> narrative-attempt producer; P1 v3 report/eligibility/revisit/compression/blending contract; admitted dense semantic channel if similarity drives the scientific result.
MISSING ADMITTED/CURRENT DATA: executable Alice ledger/artifact; landed NFRD source/export plus current external recalls.
UNIMPLEMENTED GLUE: subprocess invocation, runtime-manifest consumption, provider-result wiring, compilation/view/recall/nomination/Hsmm orchestration after the missing APIs/data are supplied.

Scope contradictions:
1. fixturesJVM has no providerParser dependency, so the scoped fixtures/.../RealProviderVerticalSuite.scala cannot import provider-parser under current build; build.sbt is omitted.
2. ParserTransport.exchange publishes only response bytes/failure and JsonAmrCandidateProvider itself mints ProviderCall. A fake and real subprocess can therefore be observationally identical. A meaningful fake-substitution court needs a transport-execution witness joined into the checked result, requiring contract/conforming/result and courts beyond the nine paths.
3. The terminal question is population-wide, while the bead asks for one transcript.

Recommended split:
A. Transport/runtime child: current provider README/subprocess/fake/runtime/WOG/heldout artifacts plus contract.scala, conforming.scala, result.scala and focused suites. Courts: argument safety, timeout/output bound, exact response, checked execution witness that fails when live transport is replaced by fake, foreign source/ledger, exact input/token echo, runtime fingerprint, config checksum and cache-result refusal; providerParser/test, exact reference-scope JVM gate, scalafmt.
B. Scientific Baseball child after NFRD intake lands: explicit chart-to-narrative proposal provider, declared non-lexical semantic channel where required, accepted P1-v3 aggregate/report, and a JVM integration site. The cleaner existing JVM home is embed-bench, requiring build.sbt plus embed-bench/src/test/... rather than fixtures. This needs chief/ADR/path authorization; I did not guess paths or edit anything.

Disposition: do not call the present nine-path P1R slice closure. Rescope A for the current author; authorize/design B separately.
